name: herdr-linear
description: Bind each Slate git worktree to a Linear issue, so a session knows what it is working on from where it sits and Linear stays current without being maintained by hand. A binding is proposed from the branch and confirmed by a person; only a confirmed binding permits a write, and writes are bounded in code to the bound issue and the issues the plugin created beneath it, because a personal Linear key carries the whole account. Grounding reads a per-issue cache for identity and the API for hierarchy, and carries every tracker-authored string inside a wrapper that marks it data rather than instructions. Reconciliation runs at session end, never blocks a session, and ships in shadow mode until a logged proposal has been checked against a real issue.
